summary: #1317 probe: H3-Image edit still, released, then MiniMax-H3 image-to-video at 544p int4; the Klein still through the same i2v.
description: Stage A of #1317 (#1345): the still-to-clip arm. Step 1 is h3-image-edit3.json's edit (same refs, prompt and recipe) with release_pipeline, so its weights are unloaded before H3 loads (the host-RAM handoff the probe measures). Step 2 is klein-edit3.json's Klein control (templates/flux3/multi-reference, same refs and intent), also released. Steps 3 and 4 run templates/minimax/image-to-video as shipped (960x544, 124 frames, int4, turbo) on the H3-Image still and then the Klein still, with one prompt, so both arms reach H3 through one chain and the second H3 load is warm. Score each clip with bench/workflows/t26-face-check.json against cast/estela.jpg and cast/aurelio.jpg. Recipe: MiniMax-H3-Image through its diffusers modular pipeline (MiniMaxH3ImageModularPipeline), transformer and text encoder SDNQ-quantized at 'weights_dtype' with H3's quantizer arguments, the transformer block-level group offloaded, the text encoder's lm_head removed and its language model truncated to 51 layers (the pipeline reads hidden_states[50]) under leaf-level offload, and the VAE on demand in bf16 (it is H3-Image's own AutoencoderKLMiniMaxH3Image, not H3's video VAE, so H3's int8 VAE recipe is not carried over). modules_to_not_convert is read off the H3-Image transformer (proj_in, context_embedder, time_embedder, time_proj, token_refiner, norm_out, pdd_proj_out), not copied from H3 video. The text encoder is loaded from MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3 at the commit the H3 templates pin (0919fb68), so it shares H3's quantized cache and the run fetches only H3-Image's transformer_diffusers and vae_diffusers (~68.6 GB), not the repo's ~204 GB. The sampler is fixed by the checkpoint (6 steps, guidance distilled): no num_inference_steps, guidance_scale or negative_prompt. Width and height are multiples of 32; min_generation_area (pipeline default 4194304, i.e. 2048x2048) upscales a smaller canvas to that area - pass 1024 to generate at the size asked for (the #1317 1024x1024 run).

variables.prompt: The woman from <Picture 1> and the man from <Picture 2> sit across from each other at a small table in the setting shown in <Picture 3>, leaning in as if mid-conversation. Keep each face, hairstyle and build exactly as in their portraits; keep the room, its light and its colour grade exactly as in <Picture 3>. Photographic, natural skin texture, medium two-shot at eye level, both faces clearly visible.
variables.video_prompt:
For the target video, at 0.00 seconds into the target video, <Picture 1> (from [Shot 1]) is fully referenced.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] Cinematic, live-action. The shot opens exactly on <Picture 1>: two people sit across a small table, leaning in mid-conversation. The woman (S1) says quietly, "You came back." The man (S2) smiles and looks down at the table, then back up at her. The camera holds a static medium two-shot at eye level; both faces stay in frame and in focus throughout.

overall_soundscape: A quiet room tone, a faint hum of distant traffic, the small creak of a chair.

non_diegetic_music: None.
variables.instruction: Place the woman from image 1 and the man from image 2 across from each other at a small table in the setting of image 3, leaning in as if mid-conversation. Keep each face, hairstyle and build exactly as in their portraits; keep the room, its light and its colour grade exactly as in image 3. Photographic, natural skin texture, medium two-shot at eye level, both faces clearly visible.
